2.text: Another prisoner coughing. Did the transfer orders say where they go?
Only the ward number. Nobody tells us what happens after that.
Keep your voice down. I'll check the passage. You watch the stairs.
The one from Cell 07. They say he opened a door he shouldn't have.
I heard he refused an order. Same thing, up here.

3.text: I need to log into this terminal. What was the password again?
Root. All lowercase. R, O, O, T. Same as last shift.
Right. Once you're in, you can disable both checkpoint cameras.
I'll watch the far passage. Don't leave the terminal open.

4.text: They sealed the ward again. Even our keys won't open that gate.
Read the experiment records first. Then use the manual release.
Fine. I'm turning back to the passage. I don't like standing here.

body.text: No... I know him. We were on shift together. Someone's here!
